description: Two independent mixers, each summing three attenuverted inputs and a fixed voltage. From the CGS Dual Processor

params.text: A fixed voltage from -5V to +5V added into that section's output
Scales the input on that row before it is summed into the section's output, and inverts it on the negative side

inputs.text: One of the three inputs summed into that section's output, scaled by its own attenuverter

outputs.text: The sum of that section's three scaled inputs and its fixed voltage
